items.difficulty_reason: Vanishing lemma (statement 1353-1359, proof 1361-1369): a globally generated non-trivial invertible sheaf has no twisted dualizing H^1 - the proof is the duality reduction plus the standard generator pairing argument; two short steps are compressed in the source (the existence of s with st nonzero, and the trivialization by a nowhere-vanishing section) but their mechanisms are the standard generator and trivialization arguments, transparent from the span. H2: short duality argument with compressed standard steps.
